def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["freight_cost"] = pd.to_numeric(df["freight_cost"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")
    df["freight_cost"] = df["freight_cost"].fillna(df["freight_cost"].median())
    df["weight_kg"] = pd.to_numeric(df["weight_kg"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    df["dispatch_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["dispatch_date"], errors="coerce")

    valid_cats = ['DHL Express', 'FedEx Ground', 'Maersk Line', 'UPS Freight', 'GIG Logistics']
    df["carrier_name"] = df["carrier_name"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["carrier_name"] = df["carrier_name"].apply(lambda x: x if x in valid_cats else "Other")
    df["origin_hub"] = df["origin_hub"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    df = df.dropna(subset=["freight_cost"]).copy()
    audit = {
        "initial_rows": int(initial_rows),
        "duplicates_removed": int(dups_removed),
        "clean_rows": int(len(df)),
        "total_freight_cost": round(float(df["freight_cost"].sum()), 2),
        "mean_freight_cost": round(float(df["freight_cost"].mean()), 2)
    }
    grp = df.groupby("carrier_name", as_index=False)["freight_cost"].sum().sort_values("freight_cost", ascending=False)
    fig = px.bar(grp, x="carrier_name", y="freight_cost", title="01 // Total Freight Cost by Carrier Name")
    return df, audit, fig
```

    df = df.copy()

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["order_total"] = pd.to_numeric(df["order_total"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["mrr_revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(df["mrr_revenue"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")
    df["mrr_revenue"] = df["mrr_revenue"].fillna(df["mrr_revenue"].median())
    df["active_seats"] = pd.to_numeric(df["active_seats"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    df["renewal_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["renewal_date"], errors="coerce")

    valid_cats = ['Enterprise', 'Pro Annual', 'Growth', 'Starter', 'Custom SLA']
    df["plan_tier"] = df["plan_tier"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["plan_tier"] = df["plan_tier"].apply(lambda x: x if x in valid_cats else "Other")
    df["region"] = df["region"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    df = df.dropna(subset=["mrr_revenue"]).copy()
    audit = {
        "initial_rows": int(initial_rows),
        "duplicates_removed": int(dups_removed),
        "clean_rows": int(len(df)),
        "total_mrr_revenue": round(float(df["mrr_revenue"].sum()), 2),
        "mean_mrr_revenue": round(float(df["mrr_revenue"].mean()), 2)
    }
    grp = df.groupby("plan_tier", as_index=False)["mrr_revenue"].sum().sort_values("mrr_revenue", ascending=False)
    fig = px.bar(grp, x="plan_tier", y="mrr_revenue", title="01 // Total MRR Revenue by Plan Tier")
    return df, audit, fig

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["ad_spend"] = pd.to_numeric(df["ad_spend"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")
    df["ad_spend"] = df["ad_spend"].fillna(df["ad_spend"].median())
    df["conversions"] = pd.to_numeric(df["conversions"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    df["launch_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["launch_date"], errors="coerce")

    valid_cats = ['LinkedIn Ads', 'Google Search', 'Organic SEO', 'TikTok Creator', 'Newsletter']
    df["acquisition_channel"] = df["acquisition_channel"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["acquisition_channel"] = df["acquisition_channel"].apply(lambda x: x if x in valid_cats else "Other")
    df["target_segment"] = df["target_segment"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    df = df.dropna(subset=["ad_spend"]).copy()
    audit = {
        "initial_rows": int(initial_rows),
        "duplicates_removed": int(dups_removed),
        "clean_rows": int(len(df)),
        "total_ad_spend": round(float(df["ad_spend"].sum()), 2),
        "mean_ad_spend": round(float(df["ad_spend"].mean()), 2)
    }
    grp = df.groupby("acquisition_channel", as_index=False)["ad_spend"].sum().sort_values("ad_spend", ascending=False)
    fig = px.bar(grp, x="acquisition_channel", y="ad_spend", title="01 // Total Ad Spend by Acquisition Channel")
    return df, audit, fig
```

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()

    df["mrr_revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(df["mrr_revenue"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["ad_spend"] = pd.to_numeric(df["ad_spend"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")
    df["ad_spend"] = df["ad_spend"].fillna(df["ad_spend"].median())
    df["conversions"] = pd.to_numeric(df["conversions"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    df["launch_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["launch_date"], errors="coerce")

    valid_cats = ['LinkedIn Ads', 'Google Search', 'Organic SEO', 'TikTok Creator', 'Newsletter']
    df["acquisition_channel"] = df["acquisition_channel"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["acquisition_channel"] = df["acquisition_channel"].apply(lambda x: x if x in valid_cats else "Other")
    df["target_segment"] = df["target_segment"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    df = df.dropna(subset=["ad_spend"]).copy()
    audit = {
        "initial_rows": int(initial_rows),
        "duplicates_removed": int(dups_removed),
        "clean_rows": int(len(df)),
        "total_ad_spend": round(float(df["ad_spend"].sum()), 2),
        "mean_ad_spend": round(float(df["ad_spend"].mean()), 2)
    }
    grp = df.groupby("acquisition_channel", as_index=False)["ad_spend"].sum().sort_values("ad_spend", ascending=False)
    fig = px.bar(grp, x="acquisition_channel", y="ad_spend", title="01 // Total Ad Spend by Acquisition Channel")
    return df, audit, fig

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()

    df["freight_cost"] = pd.to_numeric(df["freight_cost"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")

    df["carrier_name"] = df["carrier_name"].astype(str).str.strip()

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["order_total"] = pd.to_numeric(df["order_total"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")
    df["order_total"] = df["order_total"].fillna(df["order_total"].median())
    df["units_sold"] = pd.to_numeric(df["units_sold"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    df["order_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["order_date"], errors="coerce")

    valid_cats = ['Electronics', 'Home & Office', 'Apparel', 'Industrial', 'Accessories']
    df["product_category"] = df["product_category"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["product_category"] = df["product_category"].apply(lambda x: x if x in valid_cats else "Other")
    df["payment_channel"] = df["payment_channel"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    df = df.dropna(subset=["order_total"]).copy()
    audit = {
        "initial_rows": int(initial_rows),
        "duplicates_removed": int(dups_removed),
        "clean_rows": int(len(df)),
        "total_order_total": round(float(df["order_total"].sum()), 2),
        "mean_order_total": round(float(df["order_total"].mean()), 2)
    }
    grp = df.groupby("product_category", as_index=False)["order_total"].sum().sort_values("order_total", ascending=False)
    fig = px.bar(grp, x="product_category", y="order_total", title="01 // Total Order Total by Product Category")
    return df, audit, fig

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()

    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["ad_spend"] = pd.to_numeric(df["ad_spend"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")

    df["acquisition_channel"] = df["acquisition_channel"].astype(str).str.strip()

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()

    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["ad_spend"] = pd.to_numeric(df["ad_spend"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")

    df["acquisition_channel"] = df["acquisition_channel"].astype(str).str.strip()

    return df, audit, fig

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["freight_cost"] = pd.to_numeric(df["freight_cost"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")
    df["freight_cost"] = df["freight_cost"].fillna(df["freight_cost"].median())
    df["weight_kg"] = pd.to_numeric(df["weight_kg"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    df["dispatch_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["dispatch_date"], errors="coerce")

    valid_cats = ['DHL Express', 'FedEx Ground', 'Maersk Line', 'UPS Freight', 'GIG Logistics']
    df["carrier_name"] = df["carrier_name"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["carrier_name"] = df["carrier_name"].apply(lambda x: x if x in valid_cats else "Other")
    df["origin_hub"] = df["origin_hub"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    df = df.dropna(subset=["freight_cost"]).copy()
    audit = {
        "initial_rows": int(initial_rows),
        "duplicates_removed": int(dups_removed),
        "clean_rows": int(len(df)),
        "total_freight_cost": round(float(df["freight_cost"].sum()), 2),
        "mean_freight_cost": round(float(df["freight_cost"].mean()), 2)
    }

    return df, audit, fig
```

def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()

Given a messy DataFrame profile, output ONLY valid Python code defining `clean_and_analyze(df)` using `pd`, `np`, `re`, and `px` (Plotly Express). Normalize column names to snake_case, deduplicate records, parse dates and currency strings safely, filter out corrupted/injected categories into 'Other', populate an `audit` dictionary with summary metrics, and return `(df, audit, fig)`. - 'Campaign ID' (dtype=object, null%=0.0%): samples=['REC-1000', 'REC-1001', 'REC-1002', 'REC-1003']
- 'Acquisition Channel' (dtype=object, null%=0.0%): samples=['TikTok Creator', 'LinkedIn Ads', 'Google Search', 'Organic SEO']
- 'Target Segment' (dtype=object, null%=0.0%): samples=['E-Commerce', 'Consumer Apps', 'B2B SaaS', 'FinTech']
- 'Ad Spend' (dtype=object, null%=4.1%): samples=['\\$705.05', '4936.53', '4201.56', '\\$2,126.79']
- 'Conversions' (dtype=float64, null%=0.0%): samples=['239.7', '282.5', '285.1', '330.7']
- 'Launch Date' (dtype=object, null%=0.0%): samples=['2026-01-05', '2026-01-06', '2026-01-07', '2026-01-08']

Write `clean_and_analyze(df)`:

```python
def clean_and_analyze(df):
    df = df.copy()
    initial_rows = len(df)
    df.columns = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(c).strip().lower()).strip("_") for c in df.columns]
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    dups_removed = initial_rows - len(df)

    df["ad_spend"] = pd.to_numeric(df["ad_spend"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")
    df["ad_spend"] = df["ad_spend"].fillna(df["ad_spend"].median())
    df["conversions"] = pd.to_numeric(df["conversions"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    df["launch_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["launch_date"], errors="coerce")

    valid_cats = ['LinkedIn Ads', 'Google Search', 'Organic SEO', 'TikTok Creator', 'Newsletter']
    df["acquisition_channel"] = df["acquisition_channel"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["acquisition_channel"] = df["acquisition_channel"].apply(lambda x: x if x in valid_cats else "Other")
    df["target_segment"] = df["target_segment"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()

    df = df.dropna(subset=["ad_spend"]).copy()
    audit = {
        "initial_rows": int(initial_rows),
        "duplicates_removed": int(dups_removed),
        "clean_rows": int(len(df)),
        "total_ad_spend": round(float(df["ad_spend"].sum()), 2),
        "mean_ad_spend": round(float(df["ad_spend"].mean()), 2)
    }
    grp = df.groupby("acquisition_channel", as_index=False)["ad_spend"].sum().sort_values("ad_spend", ascending=False)
    fig = px.bar(grp, x="acquisition_channel", y="ad_spend", title="01 // Total Ad Spend by Acquisition Channel")
    return df, audit, fig
```
